
[[User:James Cooke Brown|JCB]]'s daughter.

There is an anecdote about Jenny that dates back to Old [[jbocre: Loglan|Loglan]] days, before the [[jbocre: GMR|GMR]].  The Loglan equivalent of ''se'' is (and always has been) ''nu''.  It was typical in those days to create lujvo by smushing together cmavo and bits of gismu in an irreversible way, as [[jbocre: rafsi|rafsi]] did not exist: for example, ''nu broda'' (the x2 conversion of broda) might have the lujvo equivalent ''nubro''.

Jenny learned some correlative pair, I don't remember exactly which one.  Suppose it was ''cninu'' (x1 is younger than x2) and ''nucni'' (nu cninu).  She then overgeneralized the apparent reversal, and started to say ''*piska'' for ''nu skapi''!

Now runs TLI: http://loglan.org/ &amp; appears to respect Lojban fine (they link here).
